'''Geoff Snider vader kicking @$$''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Geoff Snider]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10684">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10684 vader kicking @$$], DeckTech (Geoff "gsiva" Snider, 26 September 2000). == Original post ==

'''vader kicking @$$'''
* '''Author:''' Geoff "gsiva" Snider
* '''Published:''' September 26, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' winning battles is fun and profitable

=== Strategy ===

win every battle...be gay and turn luke...beat the crap out of them in space or on ground...keep luke and HOTJ off the table...etc.
